Result / explanation: new Dog("Max", "Labrador").sound() prints Animal sound, then Bark.

Also: this(...) delegates to another constructor in the same class; super(...) invokes a superclass
constructor.
Interview question: What is the difference between this and super?

Answer: this refers to the current object; super selects superclass members or calls a superclass
constructor.
Remember: this = Current object. super = Parent class access.

English: Association is a relationship between objects. Aggregation is weak whole-part ownership.
Composition is strong whole-part ownership.
සිංහල: Association කියන්Jන් objects අතර සම්බන්ධතාවයකේ. Aggregation එJකේ part එක Jවනම පෙවතින්න පුළුවන්. Composition එJකේ part එJකේ lifecycle එක whole එකට සම්බන්ධයි.
Real-world example: Doctor and patient interact; a team has players; an order owns its order lines.
Doctor — Patient → Team ◇ Player → Order ◆ OrderLine
